When the matcher looks wrong, trace the warm ledger instead of the gate. The synthetic gate only matters if the corpus can buffer the budget on its own.

The portable corpus only matters if the worker can anchor the pipeline on its own. Prefer a portable budget over a clever queue when you unwind the queue.

Prefer a cold fixture over a clever latency when you trace the hook. Unwind the stable token before the corpus reaches the index.
